endorsements.name: Joshua Dubik
endorsements.label: iOS Application Security Assessment and Automation: Introducing SIRA
endorsements.description: Apple's AppStore continues to grow in popularity, and iOS devices continue to have a high perception of security from both users and experts. However, applications on the AppStore often have security or privacy flaws that are not apparent, even to sophisticated users. Security experts can find these flaws via manual tests, but the enormity of the AppStore ensures that only a small minority of apps could ever be manually tested.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2012
